Victoria Hutter is writing to Adam Andrzejewski to dispute statements made in his recent Forbes article, clarifying that the NEA has been transparent about its funding of the Public Theater and providing evidence through multiple news articles showing the NEA disclosed this information to reporters.

The NEA declined to comment on whether the Public had applied for grants for the summer season. The Public Theater received $25,000 for the New York Voices program at Joe's Pub. Playbill has reached out regarding the application process for Shakespeare in the Park Season. Anyone can download detailed funding history from NEA grantees for the past 19 years at https://apps.nea.gov/grantsearch/
